name: skillshots-poc-first-time
description: T50: first-time visitor UX. localStorage/sessionStorage/cookies wiped before every navigation so each page-load is a brand-new user with no prior preferences, no theme choice, no language setting, no dismissed banners. Catches code paths that crash or render the wrong UI when defaults are missing. Walks the route order a real new visitor would follow: feed first (organic landing), then leaderboard (curiosity), then post-skill (action), then profile (signup), then my-wins (returning). The wipe persists across all 5 routes so each is treated independently.
